name: Montorsi 1997
question: Does early intracavernous alprostadil after nerve-sparing radical retropubic prostatectomy improve recovery of spontaneous intercourse-sufficient erections compared with observation?

arms.label: Intracavernous alprostadil three times weekly for 12 weeks

design.population: Thirty preoperatively potent men with clinical stage B1 or B2 prostate cancer, reported biopsy Gleason sums 3–6 (mean 4.2), and PSA under 20 ng/mL underwent nerve-sparing radical retropubic prostatectomy.
design.locator: Full text, Materials and Methods and patient selection table, pp 1408–1409

verdictNote: No prespecified primary endpoint or alpha; efficacy compared 12 injection completers with 15 controls.
takeaway: After nerve-sparing radical retropubic prostatectomy, alprostadil injections three times weekly for 12 weeks yielded intercourse-sufficient spontaneous erections at six months in 8/12 completers (67%); 3/15 controls (20%) reported spontaneous erections, mostly intercourse-sufficient (P < 0.01).

reports.label: Initial report
reports.dateLocator: PubMed citation and Crossref publication month: October 1997; day not specified
reports.citation: Montorsi F, Guazzoni G, Strambi LF, et al. "Recovery of spontaneous erectile function after nerve-sparing radical retropubic prostatectomy with and without early intracavernous injections of alprostadil: results of a prospective, randomized trial." *J Urol.* 1997;158(4):1408-1410. doi:10.1016/S0022-5347(01)64227-7

results.measure: Patient-reported spontaneous erection at six months; intercourse-sufficient in treated responders and mostly intercourse-sufficient in controls

values.ctl: 3/15 assigned observation (20%); most reported intercourse-sufficient erections

results.note: The report does not designate a primary endpoint or prespecified alpha; the comparison excludes three injection noncompleters. No effect estimate or confidence interval is reported.

results.endpoint: Physiologic findings among men reporting recovered erections
results.measure: Normal nocturnal erection testing and penile Doppler hemodynamics among responders

values.exp: 7/8 normal nocturnal testing; 8/8 normal Doppler hemodynamics
values.ctl: 3/3 normal nocturnal testing and Doppler hemodynamics

results.note: Responder-only testing; not a comparison of randomized groups.

results.measure: Partial spontaneous erection recovery; injection need in treated men and intromission sufficiency in controls

values.ctl: 10/15 controls (67%) reported some recovery insufficient for most intromission attempts

results.note: A further 2/15 controls (13%) reported no postoperative erectile activity.

results.measure: Cavernous veno-occlusive dysfunction on postoperative Doppler assessment
results.note: The report also describes 8/12 control failures (67%); the arm-wide comparison uses 8/15.
results.locator: Full text, Results and Discussion, p 1409

harms.label: Penile nodule
harms.note: One nodule caused treatment discontinuation; one followed a cavernous hematoma in a completer.

harms.label: Prolonged penile erection
harms.note: Occurred in a treatment completer and was treated with intracavernous epinephrine; the paper prints 6%.

delivery.label: Injection schedule
delivery.value: Intracavernous alprostadil began at the one-month postoperative visit, three times weekly for 12 weeks (36 planned injections), regardless of sexual activity.
delivery.locator: Full text, Materials and Methods, p 1409

delivery.label: Completion of injection schedule
delivery.value: 12/15 assigned alprostadil completed all 12 weeks (80%); 2/15 stopped for reduced sexual interest and 1/15 for a penile nodule.

delivery.label: Alprostadil erection-inducing dose
delivery.value: Mean 8 μg (range 2.5–14 μg) in the injection arm, individualized to a rigid, sustained erection.
delivery.locator: Full text, Materials and Methods and Results, p 1409

delivery.label: Operative technique and catheter duration
delivery.value: Nerve-sparing radical retropubic prostatectomy used the updated Walsh technique; urinary catheter duration was 8–16 days (mean 12 days).
delivery.locator: Full text, Materials and Methods, p 1409

delivery.label: Injection use among complete responders
delivery.value: Eight complete responders reported needing an injection before sexual activity once every 4.2 encounters (range once every 3–6 encounters) at the end of treatment.
